title: Approved: crawl matches mine; two status rows need a caveat
body:
I re-ran the crawl rather than reading the table, on the same 14 routes with a browser user agent, and the set of external destinations matches: the two store links, the four social links, Google Tag Manager and the Cloudflare beacon. No external destination on those pages was missed, and the App Store redirect to the zedu-chat-video-teams slug is exactly as described. That is the work the brief asked for, so this is an approval, with two rows to re-check and one finding the table does not mention.

What holds up: Apple 200 after one redirect to https://apps.apple.com/ng/app/zedu-chat-video-teams/id6759181591; Play 200 with no redirect; TikTok @telexim 200; X @teleximapp 200; both scripts 200 with the right content types. Anchor text and source pages are right, including the footer rating text used as the anchor.

Two rows I could not reproduce (checked 22 Oct 2026, from this machine):
1. Instagram. https://www.instagram.com/telex.im returned 429 after redirecting to https://www.instagram.com/accounts/login/... not 200. Instagram gates non-browser requests, so this is a measurement artefact rather than a dead link, but the row should say "200 in a browser, 429 to a script" instead of a flat 200, because a scripted re-run will contradict it.
2. Facebook. I got a direct 200 with no redirect, not the redirect to web.facebook.com recorded in the table. That is probably user-agent or region dependent; worth stating the condition.

One thing worth adding, though it is outside the brief: three of the four social links still point at the old brand, instagram.com/telex.im, tiktok.com/@telexim and x.com/teleximapp. They are not broken, so "None" under Replacement is right for this task, but an audit of outbound links is the natural place to note that the site's own social profiles still carry the Telex handles.

Score 8: complete, accurate and reproducible except for the two rows above.
